summary: Hunter thrown from a horse along Spring Camp Trail in Whitewater; Mesa County Fire Authority responded about 9:52 a.m. and hiked in to reach the injured rider, assisted by Grand Junction Fire Department, CareFlight of the Rockies and the Mesa County Sheriff's Office; CareFlight located the rider, landed nearby, and flew the hunter to a hospital
notes: Freshness sweep 2026-11-16: Junction Now report published 2026-11-15 (Sunday-verified); rider's name, age and condition not reported.
